concepts.name: ExecutedVerificationCheck
concepts.meaning: Observed local check outcome bound to exact source and generated artifacts, unlike an input or requirement.

concepts.name: CompleteRequirementAccounting
concepts.meaning: Every required check remains present; failures and unevaluated dependencies cannot become passing evidence.

concepts.name: PrivateVerificationRun
concepts.meaning: Owned temporary validation files, distinct from source authoring and target publication.

exclusions: finite structural proof implies provider correctness
